text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of a pedestrian refuge island on Ronald Avenue at the intersection with the York Beltline Trail. The refuge island will enhance safety for pedestrians and cyclists.

North York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a pedestrian refuge island on Ronald Avenue at the intersection with the York Beltline Trail, generally as shown on Drawing NYRD22-0029, dated June 2022, in Attachment 1 to the report (June 10, 2022) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
